Anika (product): Quick sync — Q2 inference-surface roadmap. Customers pressing on embeddings SLA (p50/p95 targets), chat cost controls, and reranker latency. Can we agree on primary bets by EOD?
Samir (eng-runtime): +1. My read: focus on embeddings caching + SLOs, then low-effort chat cost levers (dynamic batching + suggested quant profiles), then a targeted rerank streaming perf work.
Ben (eng-infra): Embeddings SLA needs capacity reservations. Dedicated pools for embeddings hot-path would add cost. Need commitments from sales on willing customers.
Lara (eng-sre): Also we need alerting hooks + per-model tracing before promising SLA. Will take ~2 sprints to build incident playbook.
Priya (data-science): On quality: if we cache prefixes we need evals for regressions. We have a 200-prompt suite for top 5 customers.
Anika (product): Good call. Let's list launch criteria — thinking minimal acceptance: availability, latency, and regression gate. @Samir can you draft a minimal checklist?
Samir (eng-runtime): Drafted, looped below:
```
- Availability: 99.9% per-customer across p50/p95
- Latency: embedding lookup < 80ms p95 for cached requests
- Cost: 20-30% token cost reduction for chat via autosuggest batching
- Regression: no >2% drop in quality on canonical eval suite
- Ops: on-call runbook + auto rollback
```
Ben (eng-infra): For capacity we'd need either reserved quota or burstable pricing. Proposal: reserve 2x baseline for initial SLA.
Lara (eng-sre): Ops runbook should include model-fallback policy (serve quantized variant) + regional failover.
Priya (data-science): Can we add a quality-monitoring hook that posts failures to #infra-model-alerts? I can wire the evals.
Anika (product): Decision checkpoints: 1) Prioritize embeddings SLA + prefix cache 2) Ship chat-cost pilot (small sample of customers) 3) Rerank streaming as stretch. Agree? React with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Samir (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-infra): :thumbsup:
Lara (eng-sre): :thumbsup:
Priya (data-science): :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: schedule Q2 planning doc review meeting — Tue 9:30am calendar invite sent.
Anika (product): I'll update the Q2 doc and assign owners. Owners: Samir (embeddings SLA), Ben (capacity/pricing), Lara (runbook), Priya (evals). Target: ship pilot end of Q2. Thanks everyone.
